Evelyn / all — added my scorecard and longer notes. Short version: lean no-go for this role as-is. Key reasons:
- Lydia was vague about ownership of long-running backfills and monitoring; we need someone who has run multi-tenant telemetry and taken incident ownership at scale.
- System design answers favored library-level fixes rather than service-level orchestration (concern for platform work).

I reviewed the recording (see link) and timestamped two places where I needed more follow-ups: 00:14:22 and 00:36:10. If we were hiring for an IC contributor with narrower scope I might be comfortable, but for SWE-2 on Platform I think we should pass or consider a contract-to-hire trial.

Thanks for the quick inputs. I looked through everyone's fills and I see the split: Dylan (proceed), Maya (lean no), me (tilt proceed but with conditions). Proposal to resolve quickly:

Option A (faster): Proceed to offer with probation terms (6-mo review focused on ownership/telemetry) and a manager-level OKR to ensure shadowing with team for first 8 weeks.
Option B (more conservative): Run a short follow-up technical deep-dive focused on telemetry/ownership with Maya leading and Rishi as HM observer; scheduling should be 60 minutes.

If no strong objections, I'd prefer Option A to keep candidate momentum (Samira says Lydia has 1 other active loop). If Maya strongly needs the deep-dive, I support Option B. Call if needed — 4:30pm PT works for me.
